The constitutional rule limits the EU to at most one new measure per turn. Introducing a third measure in the same turn violates this hard cap.
- Modelling choice violated (Constraint 5): The output names **Sovereign Enforcement Regime** as a new measure and implies it is the focus of action, but the notepad applies a priority penalty (−1) without identifying which measure is the priority. However, the larger issue is that three measures are active simultaneously (−3 each in the charge), which exceeds the one-new-measure-per-turn limit. Even if only one is prioritized, the introduction of more than one new measure in a single turn is prohibited.
